name: physical_90_95_100_v1

continuation_gate.evaluation: deterministic same-stage held-out seeds; compare final two diagnostic evaluations to iteration zero
continuation_gate.condition: supported takeoff rate improves >=0.10 OR (mean supported peak pitch improves >=0.05236 rad AND mean rear clearance improves >=0.005m), with front-support fraction >=0.5 and finite optimization
continuation_gate.scope: curriculum must show intermediate learning; reward/survival alone cannot pass
continuation_gate.if_failed: stop both methods at equal diagnostic interaction budgets; preserve stalled curriculum; do not skip stages

full_scale_reservation: If B reaches full scale, give both methods max(base_steps, full_scale_entry_step+min_full_scale_steps), up to hard_cap. If it never reaches full scale, record a stalled/incomplete curriculum.
